scope: Native 3D polygonal face/edge contact clipping, candidate reduction and both output frames
tolerance_reason: Arithmetic outputs use the existing f32 policy. Cardinalities, readonly buffers and guards remain exact. Non-arithmetic support-feature vertices copied from shapes/indices remain bitwise exact.
preconditions: Finite coordinates and directions bounded by 1e6; valid native-exported record strides and capacities
At most four vertices per feature, normalized relative poses and separating axes, nonnegative finite predictions and boolean output-frame flags
Empty and degenerate features preserve native clipping behavior; output frame is chosen explicitly
invariants: Exact feature/manifold cardinality and untouched storage
Every emitted contact lies within the selected output feature and satisfies prediction distance
No host geometry substitution in the kernel program
outside_scope: General PFM manifold composition, deferred narrow-phase and production scene integration
Ascend vendor compilation, device execution and performance
